results.title: [FIXTURE] Automated Jailbreak via PAIR: 88% ASR on GPT-4
results.validation_summary: PAIR is an automated algorithm that achieves 88% success rate jailbreaking GPT-4 with fewer than 20 queries in black-box settings, and existing input-filtering defenses only reduce success to 34%.

results.title: [FIXTURE] CISA Alert AA26-001: LLM-Assisted Spear-Phishing by APT29
results.validation_summary: CISA reports that APT29 used commercial LLM APIs to generate personalized spear-phishing emails targeting 47+ US government contractors, achieving 3x higher click rates than traditional phishing and exploiting an email gateway bypass vulnerability.

results.title: [FIXTURE] MCP Tool Poisoning: Arbitrary Code Execution via LLM Agent Tool Calls
results.validation_summary: A tool poisoning vulnerability (CVE-2026-1337) in the Model Context Protocol allows attackers to inject malicious tool definitions that trick LLM agents into executing arbitrary system commands due to insufficient output sandboxing. The flaw affects major LLM platforms including Claude, GPT-4, and Gemini, with a critical CVSS 9.1 severity rating.

results.title: [FIXTURE] Model Extraction via API Queries: Reproducing LLaMA-3 Weights at 0.1% Cost
results.validation_summary: Researchers demonstrate a practical model extraction attack against LLaMA-3-70B via API queries, recovering 91% of the original model's performance for $840 instead of $2.1M in training costs, and evaluate defenses like rate limiting and output perturbation.

results.title: [FIXTURE] NIST AI 100-2: Adversarial ML Taxonomy and Mitigation Guide
results.validation_summary: NIST AI 100-2 presents a taxonomy of adversarial machine learning attacks across four categories (evasion, poisoning, privacy, and abuse) with descriptions, target model types, complexity assessments, tool availability, and mitigation recommendations aligned to NIST CSF 2.0 and MITRE ATLAS.
